description:
Stream music from your Subsonic or Navidrome server Resonance is a music player for self-hosted, Subsonic-compatible servers such as Navidrome. Connect to your server and stream your own library. Features
  • Stream music from any Subsonic or Navidrome server
  • Browse artists, albums, playlists, and genres
  • A home screen of recently played, newest, most played, and random albums
  • Play, pause, skip, seek, shuffle, and repeat
  • Edit the play queue by adding, removing, and reordering tracks
  • Download original songs, albums, playlists, and artists to Music/Resonance/Artist/Album
  • Play saved music offline in the Downloads library, with progress, retry, and removal controls
  • Optionally sync favorite songs over Wi-Fi
  • Browse, search, and play your library through Android Auto
  • Background playback and a system media card with album artwork, transport controls, favorite, and repeat actions
  • Search artists, albums, and songs
  • Star artists, albums, and songs and browse your favorites
  • Artist pages with albums, tracks, a biography, and similar artists
  • Synced and plain-text lyrics with auto-scroll
  • Scrobble played tracks back to your server
  • Several color themes
Privacy
  • No analytics, tracking, or advertising
  • Network connections are initiated to the server you configure
  • Fully open source under the GNU GPLv3
